title: Dust Run
summary: Panam challenges V to a short sprint across the dry lakebed, side by side, with no checkpoints.
description: Panam challenges V to a short sprint across the dry lakebed east of the dam road, side by side, with no checkpoints. The loser buys the fuel.

start.bringUp: Bikes and a lakebed, and the loser buys the fuel. Bring up, in your own way, that you want a short race across the dry lakebed east of the dam road.

variations.know: It is dawn, and the lakebed is cold and grey.
variations.wants: V to get a clean start.

variations.know: It is dusk, and the dust is catching the last of the light.
variations.wants: V to keep up with her bike in the dust.

variations.know: It is night and they race by headlights only.
variations.wants: V to find the line in the dark.

start.name: the start line on the dry lakebed east of Laguna Bend's dam road

finish.name: the finish line on the lakebed, one straight leg away

stages.label: V races Panam across the dry lakebed
stages.objective: Race Panam across the dry lakebed to the finish line
stages.know: V and Panam line up side by side on the dry lakebed. Panam is on her bike and has her own idea of a head start.
stages.wants: V to beat Panam to the finish line.

won.memory: You beat Panam across the lakebed, and she is already asking for a rematch.

lost.memory: Panam beat you across the lakebed and has not let you forget the head start.
